defects.todo: Read `assert not constraint c { ... }` as the negation.
defects.note: Before the fence a negated assert was read as a plain constraint and decided T on all four surfaces. A negated clause whose body is one expression is now read as the plain clause over `not (body)` on every surface (numeric2 S1); a comment, `doc` or attribute member with a `=` value or none beside the expression is mapped as the plain clause maps it and only the expression is negated (solver2 S4); the shapes with no expression to negate or another member (a constraint named without a body, a specialised one, `assert not requirement`, a body of members only, a nested clause, part or calc, a `default` or `:=` member) are refused at load (mapper/negated-assert-unread) and no surface files a row for them, so no wrong verdict is reachable; the cap stays until those are read.
